owner: existing repo_source/repo_context + full manifest writer, optional pure repo_groups sibling
group_revision_algorithm: digest({group_id,member file hashes,topology relations,non-topological related relations,unresolved records,policy versions})

topology.unknown_edges: UNRESOLVED row; no invented target or guessed static resolution

related_types.HEURISTIC_TEST_CANDIDATE: non-topological filename hypothesis, no measured coverage
related_types.STATIC_TEST_IMPORT: static local dependency, not observed test coverage

ownership: UNSPECIFIED unless exact trusted map supplied; no inferred installed capability
membership: Every entry belongs to exactly one group; every INDEXED part one primary segment raw_ref

segment_policy.raw_bytes: sum immutable part bytes per segment <= policy budget
segment_policy.frame_bytes: actual compact UTF8 JSON bytes + newline <= budget
segment_policy.refs_per_segment: configurable per segment; no corpus cap
segment_policy.oversized_single_part: explicit PART_BUDGET_TOO_SMALL or REFERENCE_ROW_TOO_LARGE; no tail clipping
segment_policy.binary_lfs: raw ref survives; source-level text/code eligibility false
segment_policy.links: prev/next within group, related-link locator outside; null at actual boundaries only

storage_policy: new derived grouping directory, preserve original PR002 bytes; staged verify then atomic publish
raw_chunk_policy: never change raw part_id/logical_id/revision/ranges in old base batch
graph_memory: existing helper O(V+E); explicit resource blockers, out-of-core future scope
